written: 2026-11-06, before the semantic forget fix, sentence-level sensitive retrieval protection, per-sentence embedding and current-question filtering were implemented
note: Synthetic, fictional, non-personal. Each case has its own owner. 'quoted*' = substrings of the recall excerpts; 'sent*' = substrings of texts handed to the (fake, offline) embedding provider during that step, including the fire-and-forget indexing it starts. Sensitive = the existing classifier (memory/sensitivity.js) on ONE sentence; policy = sensitivePolicy({rememberSensitive, message: question}) unchanged.

contract.stats: recall stats carry forgottenSentences (removed by the owner's forget list) and withheldSentences (withheld by this turn's sensitive policy), counted separately

steps.ask: recallForTurn(...) with the turn's sensitive policy; optional rememberSensitive
steps.plantVector: a vector stored the way the PREVIOUS code would have: the full passage text and its hash
steps.transport: the fake provider fails ('500' | 'timeout') or works again ('ok')
